checklistGeneric: Change made only where the exception is strategic, not tolerated drift
Change communicated before it takes effect
checklistSpecific: Identify the approved exceptions that represent a deliberate appetite expansion rather than one-off accommodations
Draft the guideline amendment with the new criteria, limits, and any conditions of writing
Obtain chief underwriter approval of the amendment and record the approval reference
Publish the amended guideline with a new version number and effective date to the authority library
Communicate the change to underwriters and distribution and withdraw the superseded version

testing.expected: Amended guideline published with new version number and effective date
No superseded guideline version still available as current

checklistSpecific: Confirm the consumer profile information is complete (age, income, liquid net worth, objectives, risk tolerance, time horizon)
Check the recommended product features against the stated objectives and time horizon
Assess surrender charge exposure and liquidity needs over the surrender period
Document why the recommendation is in the consumer's best interest ahead of any producer benefit
Record the completed best-interest assessment on the case before the policy is issued

testing.expected: Completed best-interest assessment recorded before issue with full consumer profile
No contract issued with an incomplete consumer profile

checklistGeneric: Disposition recorded with a reasoned basis
checklistSpecific: Record the disposition as approved, approved with conditions, escalated, or declined
State the comparison findings that drove the disposition (cost, surrender charge, feature gain or loss)
Where escalated, cross-reference the compliance referral number on the case
Where approved, state explicitly why the replacement is in the client's interest
Save the disposition to the policy file before the contract is issued

testing.expected: Disposition with reasoned basis recorded on every replacement case
No replacement contract issued without a recorded disposition

checklistGeneric: Escalation raised as soon as the indicator is seen
checklistSpecific: Check the producer's replacement rate and any pattern of repeat replacements on the same client
Identify indicators such as replacement inside the surrender charge period or a new surrender period with no added benefit
Raise the compliance escalation through the workflow with the indicators listed and evidence attached
Place the case on hold so it cannot be issued while the escalation is open
Record the compliance outcome and the resulting action on the case before releasing or declining

testing.expected: Escalation raised with named indicators and supporting evidence attached
No case issued while a suitability escalation remains open

checklistGeneric: Every application screened, not only self-declared replacements
Flag set on the case record
checklistSpecific: Check the application replacement question and any signed replacement notice for a declared replacement
Check for 1035 exchange paperwork or a transfer request indicating an undeclared replacement
Cross-check internal in-force records for a recent surrender or reduction on the same life
Set the replacement flag on the case where any indicator is present, including undeclared ones
Retain the source documents that evidence the replacement determination on the case

testing.expected: Replacement flag set where 1035 or replacement notice documentation exists
No case holding 1035 documentation without the replacement flag set

checklistGeneric: Notice version matches the state of solicitation
checklistSpecific: Identify the state of solicitation and select the correct state replacement notice version
Issue the notice to the applicant and record the delivery date and method
Notify the existing insurer within the state-required number of days of the application
Diary the response window and confirm no issue occurs before it expires where the state requires it
File proof of sending for both applicant and existing insurer on the policy record

testing.expected: State replacement notice and proof of sending filed for applicant and existing insurer
No replacement case where the existing-insurer notice date falls outside the state timeframe

checklistGeneric: Reviewer independent of the original determination
checklistSpecific: Confirm the consumer profile supports the recommendation and is internally consistent
Test the stated basis of recommendation against the product features actually recommended
Check the surrender charge and cost comparison were performed and the figures are sourced
Record agreement or disagreement with the suitability determination and, if disagreeing, the required remediation
Sign off the supervisory review with reviewer name and date before the case can proceed to issue

testing.expected: Supervisory review sign-off recorded with reviewer name and date

checklistGeneric: Filed to the state retention requirement
checklistSpecific: File the replacement notices, comparison, suitability assessment, and supervisory sign-off as one pack
Apply the retention period required by the state of solicitation, taking the longest where multiple apply
Index the pack by policy number, insured, state, and issue date for examiner retrieval
Confirm the stored pack is read-only and versioned once filed
Spot-check retrieval against a market conduct examination request format

testing.expected: Complete replacement pack filed with state retention period applied
No replacement record missing the supervisory sign-off document

checklistGeneric: Comparison uses current values from both contracts
checklistSpecific: Obtain current values on the existing contract: cash value, surrender charge remaining, death benefit, guarantees, riders
Set out the proposed contract equivalents side by side including any new surrender charge period
Quantify the cost of replacing: surrender charge incurred, new acquisition cost, lost guarantees or riders
Identify the benefit gained and test whether it justifies the quantified cost
Write the suitability conclusion on the case referencing the comparison figures

testing.expected: Side-by-side comparison of existing and proposed contract values recorded
No replacement approved where the comparison shows cost exceeding benefit without stated justification

checklistGeneric: Routed through the workflow with the full pack
checklistSpecific: Assemble the suitability findings pack: profile, comparison, disposition, and supervisory review
Route the pack to the compliance sign-off queue through the workflow, not by email
State the specific question compliance is being asked to sign off where the case is finely balanced
Track the sign-off against the case SLA and chase where it is overdue
Record the compliance sign-off decision and any conditions on the case before issue

testing.expected: Suitability findings pack routed to compliance with a recorded sign-off outcome
No replacement case issued without a recorded compliance sign-off

checklistGeneric: Outcome reflected in the final terms
checklistSpecific: Compare proposed price against technical price and state the shortfall in both percentage and premium terms
Test the rate change against the expiring rate and against the class rate movement in the portfolio
Challenge each term concession (deductible, sublimit, extension) that is not priced for
Record the underwriter's response and supporting evidence against each challenge point
Confirm the final terms either reflect the challenge or carry a documented decision to override it

testing.expected: Recorded pricing challenge with technical-vs-proposed price shortfall stated

checklistGeneric: Escalation raised as soon as the CUO ceiling is exceeded
checklistSpecific: Confirm the risk exceeds the CUO authority ceiling on premium, limit, or appetite and state which
Prepare the committee submission with risk summary, pricing, portfolio impact, and CUO recommendation
Submit to the underwriting committee through the governance workflow with the required lead time
Confirm no indication or commitment has been given to the broker pending committee decision
Record the committee reference number and scheduled decision date on the referral

testing.expected: Committee submission logged with CUO recommendation and reference number
No quote released on an over-CUO-authority risk before committee decision

checklistGeneric: Sign-off recorded by the authority holder in their own name
checklistSpecific: Record the sign-off decision with the authority level relied on and confirm it covers the full exposure
Enter each condition attached to the sign-off as a separate trackable line
State the validity period of the sign-off and the trigger for re-referral if terms change
Confirm the sign-off is recorded under the authority holder's own user, not a delegate's
Verify the sign-off record flows to the authority-usage audit extract

testing.expected: Sign-off recorded with authority level, conditions, and validity period

checklistGeneric: Package assessed against the current appetite version

Test the requested limit against the class per-risk limit and the programme aggregate limit
Check the territory and jurisdiction are within the licensed and appetite-permitted footprint
